summary: Completed the Phase 1 HTTP discovery and consumer CLI slice. The reference fetcher now normalizes the well-known endpoint, follows bounded redirects with observable cross-origin hops, rejects unsafe schemes, userinfo, private or reserved DNS answers, non-default ports, loops, oversized bodies, missing JSON content types, and timeout/network failures. Local check, fetch, schema, explain, and doctor commands are available with explicit offline defaults; deterministic in-process HTTP fixtures cover the transport boundary.
